explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and it fires only at D1 when the previous trial was an a2 choice that went to S1 (rare) and got no reward. In those cases it is about 10 in early trials (up to about 25), about 8 around trials 30-40, about 3-6 around trials 50-58, and 0 from about trial 60 on, and it stays 0 after any other kind of previous trial (rewarded, a common transition, or an a1 choice).
